answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 11243 Country: Pakistan Title: After first interaction with my husband, I have taken bath but bleeding was not stop, pls guide shall I take bath again in order to offer pray or something else, pls advise at your earliest. Question: After first interaction with my husband, I have taken bath but bleeding was not stop, pls guide shall I take bath again in order to offer pray or something else, pls advise at your earliest. Answer ID: 11243 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 300/274=B/1430) You will have to bath again when the bleeding will stop. The salah will not be valid if the bleeding continued. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
